title: YHWH (Jehovah) in ancient Hebrew letters: Hand Reveals, Nail Reveals
summary: The divine name y-a-h-w-e-h (Jehovah) shown as the four Hebrew letters he, vav, he, yod, each with its ancient picture sign and meaning: he = Reveal, vav = Nail, yod = Hand. The slide concludes 'Hand Reveals, Nail Reveals.' The yod/Hand and vav/Nail are colour-coded.

text.text: y a h w e h (Jehovah)

words.gloss: the name of God, shown as 'Jehovah'

pictures.description: Four ancient (paleo-Hebrew) letter signs in a row, each with a coloured underline: he (a figure with raised arms, black), vav (a nail or peg shape, orange), he again (black), and yod (a hand/arm shape, dark red). Below each sign is its meaning: Reveal, Nail, Reveal, Hand.

uncertain: Hebrew letters are shown left to right as he, vav, he, yod (as in the slide's labels); the Hebrew block is written in logical right-to-left order as the name YHWH
